performance.scope: All saved accounts reach a bounded terminal state, with the active account prioritised.
performance.current: Account Runtime reports total restore duration, Active Account terminal time, and one bounded terminal outcome per saved Account.

performance.scope: The selected account, visible projections, and repaired destination become coherent together.
performance.current: Account Runtime reports total switch duration, projection-barrier duration, and acknowledged projection count. The current Workspace adapter releases the outgoing conversation before commit and repairs the requested room or space only after all live active-account projections acknowledge their new generation.

performance.scope: A visible conversation attaches its keyed projections and becomes presentable.
performance.current: Conversation Runtime reports the last synchronous child attach-to-presentable duration. The production RoomShellNavigation journey focuses an immutable Account-and-Room key and every room surface consumes the focused timeline child interface.

performance.scope: A normalized Matrix event becomes a safe presented message.
performance.current: Message Presentation reports content-free event count, batch duration, and average per-event duration while turning normalized text and system events into immutable render models. Focused tests exercise representative plain, formatted, hostile, and system-event batches.

performance.scope: A semantic destination reaches a coherent Workspace view and canonical URL.
performance.unit: milliseconds to view and route commit
performance.current: Existing router-driven room navigation; instrumentation is introduced by #310 and #311.

performance.scope: Blurred, retained, and evicted conversations release listeners and memory according to policy.
performance.unit: handles, listeners, and retained bytes per account
performance.current: Projection Runtime reports handles, listeners, and deterministic retained payload bytes. The sync-state tracer retains one listener and at most 40 bytes across distinct published and pending enum values per live Account. Conversation Runtime retains at most two blurred handles per Account; each keeps 11 browser listeners, the latest 100 projected events, at most 200 sender dependencies, and at most 11,200 deterministic modeled bytes. Eviction and teardown return a child to zero resources.

performance.scope: Connected inactive accounts continue normal sync without unbounded application projection work.
performance.unit: CPU time per minute per inactive account
performance.current: Projection Runtime records reconciliation count and wall time; the sync-state tracer coalesces each event burst to one reconciliation per live Account without duplicating SDK state.

security.invariant: Matrix events are normalized before capability and presentation code consumes them.
Credentials, secret material, message bodies, and precise location are absent from diagnostics.
security.enforcement: Typed failure metadata and hostile-adapter tests

security.invariant: Matrix SDK imports remain inside approved Matrix adapters and pure Matrix modeling utilities.
security.enforcement: ESLint import boundaries and architecture dependency checks

security.invariant: Electron IPC is versioned, sender-validated, and capability-scoped.
security.enforcement: Host adapter contract and IPC security tests

security.invariant: Sensitive preferences declare storage and export restrictions.
security.enforcement: Preference catalog validation and export-schema guards
